title: Our Father
body: [[plain]]Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name; thy kingdom come, thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Glory Be
body: [[plain]]Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Prayer to St. Joseph
description: A prayer asking St. Joseph to protect and assist us.
body:
[[heading]]PRAYER TO ST. JOSEPH.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Blessed Joseph, we come to you in our troubles, and after asking the help of your holy Spouse, we also confidently ask for your protection. By the love with which you loved the Blessed Virgin, Mother of God, and by the fatherly care with which you cared for the Child Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]We earnestly ask you to look kindly upon us, the portion of Jesus Christ redeemed by his blood, and to assist us in our troubles by your power and intercession.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O faithful Guardian of the Holy Family, protect the chosen children of Jesus Christ. O father who has loved us greatly, keep us from every defect of deception and error.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O our powerful protector, assist us from Heaven where you are, as we struggle against the powers that dwell in darkness. As in former times you rescued the Child Jesus from danger of death, so now protect the Holy Church of God from the snares of the enemy and from every hardship.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Always care for each one of us, that by your example and with your help we may live holy lives, die a good death, and be received into Heaven, the dwelling of eternal peace. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Hail Holy Queen
description: A prayer to the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of Mercy.
body:
[[heading]]HAIL HOLY QUEEN[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of mercy, our life, our comfort, and our hope. To you we cry in this exile, we children of Eve. To you we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Turn then, most gracious advocate, your eyes of mercy toward us, and after this our exile, show unto us Jesus, the blessed fruit of your womb.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]O gentle, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.[[/plain]]

title: Morning Prayer
description: A morning prayer order with offering, basic prayers, commandments, and the Angelus.
body:
[[response]]LET US PRAY THE MORNING PRAYER.[[/response]]

[[plain]]+In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Let us praise the Most Holy Trinity, one God, now and always and forever. Amen. O Most Holy Trinity of Almighty God; +Father, +Son, and +Holy Spirit. I believe that you are here and everywhere.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O my God, you created me, redeemed me, made me a Christian, increased your graces in me, and prepared my dwelling in Heaven.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O my God, I adore you, thank you, ask your pardon, and love you. O my God, I offer you my soul, thoughts, words, work, joy, and sufferings. Receive them and give me your grace so that I may not sin today. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O Father, our great God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]You protected me this night.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]I thank you with my heart,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]O Father, Son, and Spirit.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Protect me again this day,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Let me avoid sin and obey you.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]I ask you, Father,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]May I receive your blessings.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Pure Virgin, O Mary,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Stand by me so I may not be lost.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Great guardian angel,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Pray for me to our God.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]May I desire and do only good,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]And at the end come to you above. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]GOOD INTENTION.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]To honor my God[[/plain]]
[[plain]]I offer him my soul,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]May I work and rest[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Keeping only his commandments.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Every thought, word, and deed[[/plain]]
[[plain]]I offer wholly to God.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]My soul and body, all that is mine,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]My love and my life,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]I will love my God,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]And I will not commit sin.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]I praise your name,[[/plain]]
[[plain]]May your will be done.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]In obedience I endure[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Suffering and troubles also.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Give me, Lord, your graces[[/plain]]
[[plain]]That I may increase your praise. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]PRAYER OF OFFERING.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]O Jesus, through the hands of the Virgin Mary, and in union with your great sacrifice, I offer you all my prayers, actions, troubles, and joys of today. O Jesus, may your Kingdom come to us.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]OUR FATHER.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in Heaven.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Give us this day our daily bread. Forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]HAIL MARY.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Hail, Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]THE APOSTLES' CREED.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]I believe in God the Father Almighty, Creator of Heaven and earth. And in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord. He was conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit and born of the Virgin Mary. He suffered under Pontius Pilate. He was crucified, died, and was buried. He descended into hell. On the third day he rose again from the dead. He ascended into Heaven and is seated at the right hand of God the Father Almighty. From there he will come again to judge the living and the dead.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]THE COMMANDMENTS OF GOD.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]1. I am the Lord your God; you shall not worship other gods.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]2. You shall not take the name of your God in vain.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]3. Keep holy the day of God.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]4. Honor your father and mother, that you may have many years and blessings on earth.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]5. You shall not kill.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]6. You shall not commit adultery.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]7. You shall not steal.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]8. You shall not lie.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]9. You shall not covet a woman who is not your wife.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]10. You shall not covet another person's goods.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]THE COMMANDMENTS OF THE CHURCH.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]1. Attend Holy Mass on Sundays and holy days of obligation.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]2. Fast on Ash Wednesday; do not eat meat on Good Friday.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]3. Confess your sins at least once each year.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]4. Receive the Holy Eucharist especially during Easter.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]5. Support the Catholic Church with offerings.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]6. Observe Catholic marriage law.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O Mary, Holy Virgin, Mother of God and my Mother, and you Saint Joseph, and you my guardian angel, and you my patron saints, and all you saints, pray for me that I may leave sin; protect me today and always, and at the hour of my death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF FAITH.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I believe all the truths believed and taught by the Roman Catholic Church, because you have revealed them to us. You are not deceived, and you do not deceive. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF HOPE.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I hope in you, that through Jesus Christ I will be given your graces here on earth and glory in Heaven, because you have promised these things to us and you are faithful. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF LOVE.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I love you above all things, because you are good and lovable. I love my neighbor as myself for your sake. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF CONTRITION.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I am very sorry for the sins I have committed against you, because you are good and lovable. Sin displeases you, so I do not want to sin again. I will do penance; I ask your grace so that I may return. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]PRAYER TO THE GUARDIAN ANGEL.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My guardian angel, protect me from all dangers of soul and body. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]THE ANGELUS[[/heading]]

[[plain]]•The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary, and she conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]~Hail, Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]•Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done unto me according to your word.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]~Hail, Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]•And the Word of God was made flesh and dwelt among us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]~Hail, Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God, that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Let us pray:[[/response]]
[[plain]]Pour forth, we beseech you, O Lord, your grace into our hearts, that we to whom the incarnation of Christ your Son was made known by the message of an angel may, by his Passion and Cross, be brought to the glory of the Resurrection. We ask this through Christ our Lord. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]MARY, QUEEN OF PEACE, PRAY FOR US![[/heading]]

[[plain]]We wish you a good day in the name of the +Father, and of the +Son, and of the +Holy Spirit. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Evening Prayer
description: An evening prayer order with thanksgiving, confession, contrition, Angelus, and guardian angel prayer.
body:
[[heading]]EVENING PRAYER.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]We thank you, O God, for all the good things you have given us this day.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]OUR FATHER.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in Heaven.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Give us this day our daily bread. Forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]HAIL MARY.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Hail Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF FAITH.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I believe all the truths believed and taught by the Roman Catholic Church, because you have revealed them to us. You are not deceived, and you do not deceive. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF HOPE.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I hope in you, that through Jesus Christ I will be given your graces here on earth and glory in Heaven, because you have promised these things to us and you are faithful. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF LOVE.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I love you above all things, because you are good and lovable. I love my neighbor as myself for your sake. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]CONFESSION OF SINS.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]Let us think in our hearts of all the sins of today by which we have offended God, in thought, word, and deed (………………………)[[/plain]]

[[plain]]I confess to Almighty God, and to you, my brothers and sisters, that I have greatly sinned, in my thoughts, in my words, in my actions, and in failing to fulfill my duty. I have sinned, I have sinned, I have greatly sinned. Therefore I ask blessed Mary ever Virgin, the angels and all the saints, and you, my brothers and sisters, to pray for me to the Lord our God.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]+May Almighty God have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ACT OF CONTRITION.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My God, I am very sorry for the sins I have committed against you, because you are good and lovable. Sin displeases you, so I do not want to sin again. I will do penance; I ask your grace so that I may return. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O merciful God, pour out your blessings upon our Holy Father Francis, the bishops, priests, deacons, farmers, all workers, students, and the whole community whom you make your people. Save those who do not yet know you, comfort the sick, and guide those who are dying so they may see the light of eternity. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]ANGELUS.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary, and she conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]~Hail Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done unto me according to your word.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]~Hail Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]And the Word of God was made flesh and dwelt among us.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]~Hail Mary, full of grace; the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is Jesus, the fruit of thy womb. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God, that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.[[/plain]]

[[response]]Let us pray:[[/response]]
[[plain]]Pour forth, we beseech you, O Lord, your grace into our hearts, that we to whom the incarnation of Christ your Son was made known by the message of an angel may, by his Passion and Cross, be brought to the glory of the Resurrection.[[/plain]]
[[plain]]We ask this through Christ our Lord.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Mary, Queen of Peace ~ Pray for us![[/plain]]

[[heading]]PRAYER TO THE GUARDIAN ANGEL.[[/heading]]

[[plain]]My guardian angel, protect me from all dangers of soul and body. Amen.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Prayer to St. Joseph for the Pilgrim Church
description: A prayer to St. Joseph as heavenly Patron and Protector of the Church.
body:
[[plain]]O glorious Saint Joseph, chosen by Almighty God to be the Foster-Father of Jesus, the most chaste Spouse of Mary Ever-Virgin, and the Head of the Holy Family. Thou hast been chosen by the Vicar of Christ as the heavenly Patron and Protector of the Church founded by Christ. Therefore, with greatest confidence, I implore thy powerful assistance for the entire Church throughout the world.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Guard with a truly fatherly love, in a special manner, the Sovereign Pontiff, and all Bishops and Priests in communion with the See of Peter. Be thou the protector of all who labor for the salvation of souls amidst the trials and tribulations of this life; and grant that all peoples of the earth may follow Christ and the Church which He established.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Beloved Saint Joseph, accept the offering of myself which I now make. I consecrate myself to thy service, that thou mayest ever be my father, my protector, and my guide in the way of salvation. Obtain for me a great purity of heart and a fervent desire for the spiritual life. Grant that all my actions, after thine own example, may be directed to the praise and glory of God, in union with the Divine Heart of Jesus, the Immaculate Heart of Mary, and thy fatherly heart. Intercede for me, that I may share in thy happy and holy death.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Act of Entrustment to the Protection of Saint Joseph
description: An act of entrustment placing oneself under the protection of St. Joseph.
body:
[[plain]]O Saint Joseph, Foster-Father of my Savior, and most chaste Spouse of the Mother of God, this day I choose thee to be my advocate before Almighty God, as well as my model, my protector, and my father in this valley of exile.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]O Saint Joseph, whom the Lord didst constitute the guardian of His own Holy Family, I beseech thee to be my good protector in all my affairs. Kindle within my heart the fire of a great love for Jesus, and enable me to serve Him with zeal and fidelity after thine own example. Aid me in my weakness to honor the Blessed Mother Mary as my Mediatrix.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Be thou ever my guide in the path of virtue and piety; and grant that, having faithfully followed thee in the way of righteousness, I may receive thy powerful protection in the hour of my death.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Prayer to Saint Joseph for the Unemployed
description: A prayer to St. Joseph, Patron of workers, for the unemployed and for those seeking honest work.
body:
[[plain]]O Saint Joseph, we beseech thee on behalf of those who are without employment, and for those who desire to earn their living and provide sustenance for their families.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Thou art the Patron of workers; grant that there may be none among us lacking employment, and that all who stand ready to labor may direct their strength and talents to the service of their fellow men and the earning of an honest livelihood.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Thou art the Patron of families; leave not those who have children to cherish and bring up without the means to do so. Have compassion upon our brethren who are unemployed and cast down into poverty by reason of sickness or unjust social structures. Assist our political leaders and those who hold the reins of industry and production, that they may devise new and just solutions to this affliction.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Grant that each of us may obtain a lawful income and rejoice in the opportunity to share, according to our ability, in a better life for all. Grant that we may all partake together of the resources wherewith Almighty God hath blessed us, and vouchsafe that we may ever be ready to succor those whose need is greater than our own.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Amen.[[/plain]]

title: Prayer to Saint Joseph to Discern One's Vocation
description: A prayer to St. Joseph to discern and embrace the state of life God wills for us.
body:
[[plain]]O glorious Saint Joseph, who didst perfectly obey the guidance of the Holy Ghost, obtain for me the grace to know the state of life which Almighty God willeth me to embrace.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Suffer me not to be deceived in a matter so momentous, whereon my happiness here below, and even the eternal salvation of my soul, depend.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Grant that, being enlightened by the divine will and remaining faithful in fulfilling it, I may embrace the path which God hath prepared for me, and which shall lead me to everlasting bliss.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]Amen.[[/plain]]
